name: Percy Liang

affiliations.role: Professor of Computer Science; founding director of CRFM

bio: Percy Liang is a professor of computer science at Stanford and the founding director of its Center for Research on Foundation Models. Their research spans machine learning, natural language processing, and foundation models, and they teach the Language Models from Scratch course. They also lead Marin, an open model-development effort, and co-developed CodaLab Worksheets.
known_for: CS336 Language Models from Scratch course
